name: What is the typical process for adding a fire pit to an outdoor living space with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for adding a fire pit to an outdoor living space with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for adding a fire pit begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and assess your existing outdoor space. From there, we develop a detailed design, including CAD-supported layouts, that integrates the fire pit seamlessly with other outdoor elements like patios or kitchens. This design phase ensures functionality, aesthetics, and proper placement. Following design approval, our team manages all construction, ensuring craftsmanship and clear communication from concept to final walkthrough, providing a single point of coordination for the entire project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process starts with a consultation, moves to detailed CAD-supported design, then includes managed construction and installation, all coordinated by our single team.
